rules.title: Vendor Master Maintenance x AP Invoice Entry
rules.risk: User can create or alter a fictitious vendor and post fraudulent invoices against it.
rules.remediation: Split vendor master maintenance (XK01/FK01/BP) and invoice posting (FB60/MIRO) across separate roles and users.

rules.title: Vendor Master Maintenance x Payment Execution
rules.risk: User can modify vendor bank details and execute unauthorized outgoing payments.
rules.remediation: Separate vendor master maintenance from payment execution (F110/F-53/F-58) and enforce dual control on bank changes.

rules.title: Bank Master Maintenance x Payment Execution
rules.risk: User can define rogue bank routing data and trigger outgoing payment runs.
rules.remediation: Restrict FI01/FI12 to treasury master data administrators with no payment run authorization.

rules.title: User Administration x Role Administration
rules.risk: User can build privileged roles in PFCG and assign them to any user account via SU01/SU10.
rules.remediation: Separate user administration (SU01/SU10) from role design and profile generation (PFCG/SU24).

rules.title: AP Invoice Entry x Payment Execution
rules.risk: User can enter an accounts payable invoice and immediately disburse funds without independent review.
rules.remediation: Segregate AP invoice entry (FB60/MIRO) from payment run execution (F110/F-53/F-58).

rules.title: Purchase Order Creation x Purchase Order Release
rules.risk: User can create a purchase order and approve it unilaterally, bypassing procurement release strategy.
rules.remediation: Remove ME28/ME29N from operational buyer roles and restrict PO release to authorized approvers.

rules.title: Purchase Order Creation x Goods Receipt Posting
rules.risk: User can order goods and confirm fictitious receipts in MIGO to trigger three-way match payment.
rules.remediation: Segregate purchasing roles (ME21N/ME22N) from warehouse receiving roles (MIGO).

rules.title: AP Invoice Entry x Goods Receipt Posting
rules.risk: User can post both goods receipt and vendor invoice to manipulate three-way match controls.
rules.remediation: Assign MIGO to warehouse personnel and FB60/MIRO to accounts payable clerks.

rules.title: Customer Master Maintenance x AR Billing/Incoming Payment
rules.risk: User can alter customer credit or master data and post receivables or credit memos to conceal fraud.
rules.remediation: Separate customer master maintenance (XD01/FD01/VD01) from AR posting (F-28/FB70/FB75).

rules.title: ABAP Development x Transport Management
rules.risk: User can write custom ABAP code and import transports into production without peer review.
rules.remediation: Revoke SE38/SE80/SE37/SE24 in production and restrict STMS import rights to Basis administrators.

rules.title: GL Journal Entry x Parked Document Release
rules.risk: User can park and release general ledger journals without four-eyes review.
rules.remediation: Split FB50/FB01 posting rights from FBV0 parked document release authorization.
